property.name: allowedEntities
property.description-key: Comma-separated list of entity logical names allowed to be selected as the query or link-entity target (e.g. account,contact)

property.name: requiredAttributes
property.description-key: JSON array of attributes that must always be included as columns when their entity is present in the query. attribute is required. entity is optional and defaults to the root entity when omitted, or set it to a related link entity name. alias is optional to specify, but is always applied when given.

property.name: requiredAlias
property.description-key: JSON array validating that a given output alias is present somewhere in the query and bound to an attribute of an allowed type. alias and binding are both required; binding is an array of one or more of id, string, decimal, integer, long, float, double, boolean, lookup.
